decisions.reason: The FAQ describes the current referral and prize mechanics generically; the contract migration does not necessarily require migration-specific FAQ copy.
An existing same-message MODIFY already limits referral-count accounting to replacement-contract NFTs and excludes old-contract records.

Starting new NFTs and draws does not change the Small Block ticket issuance, eligibility, reset, or carryover rules; exclusion of old ticket state is already owned by the source accounting Requirement.
An existing same-message MODIFY already requires the countdown to use only the replacement contract's new draw cycle.
An existing same-message MODIFY already scopes public referral statistics to replacement-contract referrals and excludes old-contract data.
An existing same-message MODIFY already makes the public statistic use only the replacement contract's new prize-pool state.
An existing same-message MODIFY already excludes old-contract NFTs and restarts replacement-contract NFT numbering at #1.
An existing same-message MODIFY already limits dashboard ownership inventory to successfully minted replacement-contract NFTs and excludes old-contract NFTs.

The accepted migration does not necessarily change the requirement that newly earned referral commissions appear immediately; the candidate contains no historical-earnings source rule requiring replacement.
Replacement NFTs still use their own mint numbers as referral codes and retain the specified metadata attributes; the source decision does not require changing these generic metadata rules.
The About page describes the active product mechanics without asserting that old-contract NFTs or draw state remain in use, so its current copy remains valid.
Changing the contract and excluding old-contract state does not alter the requirement to render NFT images and covers correctly.
